definition.text: Appointed; a substitute, the third son of Adam and Eve (Gen. 4:25; 5:3). His mother gave him this name, “for God,” said she, “hath appointed me [i.e., compensated me with] another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.”

lemmas.kjv: bewray, that are bidden, call, cry

lemmas.gloss: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality
